tagline: One JSON file restyles an entire UI
brief: An open-source live theme editor for design tokens, for frontend developers. It should feel precise, adaptable and crafted, and avoid the palette, brush and colour-wheel clichés of design tools.
criteria: Success: reads as a T at 16 px, works in one colour, carries the 'built from tokens' idea, and can take on any theme's accent.

concepts.name: Token T
concepts.idea: A T assembled from two design tokens: a pill-shaped swatch resting on a square stem.
rationale: Two radius tokens in one letter: fully round and square
The pill takes each theme's accent, so the logo is themeable too
Simple geometry on an 8-unit grid; a heavier cut for 16 px

recommendation: Token T in Token Blue #4a6cf7 and Ink #0b0d12, with #7c9cff and #e8eaf0 on dark surfaces.
next_steps: Use the horizontal lockup in the README and nav
Use the app icon for social avatars
Keep the pill in an accent colour wherever the logo appears
